article.title: Ethiopia's Top 10 Budget Expenditures For 2022/2023
article.description: For the first time in many years, funding for roads is no longer the largest budgetary line-item, being replaced instead by allocations for debt service (Birr 126bn) and defense (Birr 84bn). Shifts in policy priorities are also reflected in line-items showing substantial increments from last year, most notably for transfers/subsidies (up 9.6x), defense (up 3.8x), and debt service (up 2.8x)
